effective_plan.goal: Improve non-desklamp execution so that (1) search for an initially hidden exact target advances through new receptacles rather than oscillating, and stays within the 50-step budget; (2) tasks requiring cooling or heating perform one conditioning action on the exact held target at the open appliance without close/open or remove/reinsert cycles, then proceed to the destination; and (3) successful exact-category multi-instance delivery is preserved. Respect the Actor's limited two-step history by making rules depend on the current observation, admissible commands, and numbered receptacle names rather than a global visited set. Preserve the existing exact-category matching, general acquisition/placement, and desklamp-scoped rules.

updates.text: Search rule for tasks whose exact target is not initially visible: run a single forward sweep that does not oscillate. Treat each inspected receptacle as consumed; the next move should go to a different receptacle, ideally one not just inspected. Use the numbered receptacle names as a local progress cue: after checking an instance of a family, prefer the next higher-numbered unvisited instance or a wholly uninspected family or surface instead of jumping back to an earlier location. Open each closed container once and read its contents; if it is empty, continue forward to a new receptacle rather than cycling back through earlier ones. Include cheap surface checks (countertops, desks, beds, tables, shelves) early in the sweep. Continue until the exact requested category is found or all plausible receptacles have been inspected once, keeping within the step budget.

Conditioning rule for tasks that require the exact target to be cooled or heated: after acquiring the exact target, go to the required appliance (fridge for cool, microwave for heat). Perform the cool/heat action on the held target as soon as it is admissible, including while holding it at a closed appliance, without first inserting it; holding the target is sufficient in the observed environment. Open the appliance only if the action is not yet offered for the held target. Do not treat inserting the target, closing or reopening the door, or examining the appliance as completing the temperature change. If the action is never offered for the held target, place the target inside once and perform the action there, but never replace conditioning with repeated close/open or remove/reinsert cycles. Perform one conditioning action, then carry the target to the requested destination (opening it if closed) and place it there. If the conditioning appliance is also the destination, condition the target and then place it there.

Quantity rule for ordinary multi-instance placement: when the task requires two or more instances of the exact category, deliver them sequentially. After placing the first exact instance at the destination, continue searching (from remaining uninspected receptacles or a known source) for another instance of the same exact category and repeat until the requested count is placed. Do not stop after one, do not substitute a differently named near-match, and do not apply the desklamp rule of finishing with one co-located target to ordinary multi-instance put tasks.
